svg.title: Monte Carlo | regime_v3 | 32 paths
svg.desc: 120 hourly candles and volume bars for path 00. Thin grey lines trace the closing prices of paths 01–31. Blue, purple and gold show the 5th, 50th and 95th percentiles each hour.

g.text: Candles and volume show path 00. Each thin grey line follows one of the other 31 paths.
The three coloured lines summarize all 32 closing prices at each hour.
